**Step 1: Convert the distance covered by 1 US gallon from miles to kilometers.**
The car travels 35.6 miles on 1 US gallon.
$$ \text{Distance in km} = 35.6 \text{ miles} \times 1.609344 \frac{\text{km}}{\text{mile}} $$
$$ \text{Distance in km} = 57.2926464 \text{ km} $$

**Step 2: Identify the volume of fuel consumed in litres.**
The car consumes 1 US gallon of fuel.
$$ \text{Volume in litres} = 1 \times 3.785411784 \frac{\text{litres}}{\text{gallon}} $$
$$ \text{Volume in litres} = 3.785411784 \text{ litres} $$

**Step 3: Calculate the fuel consumption in litres per kilometer.**
$$ \text{Consumption (L/km)} = \frac{\text{Volume in litres}}{\text{Distance in km}} $$
$$ \text{Consumption (L/km)} = \frac{3.785411784}{57.2926464} $$

**Step 4: Convert to litres per 100 km.**
To find the consumption for 100 kilometers, multiply the result from Step 3 by 100.
$$ \text{Consumption (L/100km)} = \frac{3.785411784}{57.2926464} \times 100 $$
$$ \text{Consumption (L/100km)} = \frac{378.5411784}{57.2926464} $$

**Step 5: Perform the division.**
$$ \frac{378.5411784}{57.2926464} \approx 6.60715121... $$

**Step 6: Round to 2 decimal places.**

$$ 6.607... \approx 6.61 $$

ANSWER: 6.61
